question: What is the scope of the reality to be meditated upon in each place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place
That reality is the object of meditation
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality which extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated in each and every place on that which extends from Śiva down to Avīci...
